verdict.rationale: BILL's first-party v3 API docs say developers can set up virtual cards and budgets for Spend & Expense, and a recipe covers S&E users, budgets, and cards, so programmatic card issuance is documented. Nothing in the pack shows locking or freezing a card, updating card controls, or setting a per-card spending limit through the API. Missing for 10: documented card lock/freeze endpoint, card control update endpoint, explicit per-card limit parameter, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue and manage cards programmatically — create a card with a limit, lock it, update controls — via the public API

citations.quote: Build with card & expense management services. Set up budgets, users, & virtual cards.
